name: Bashal'Aran
summary: Bashal'Aran lies in northern Darkshore, east of Auberdine, where satyrs and grells feed on lingering magic. A solitary elven ghost remains trapped by a centuries-old curse.

sections.title: A Shattered Twin City
sections.body: Before the Great Sundering shattered ancient Kalimdor ten thousand years ago, Queen Azshara settled favored Highborne in Bashal'Aran and its twin, Ameth'Aran. The powerful mage Athrikus Narassin governed both towns, whose splendid markets and temples honored Elune. When the Well of Eternity collapsed, the cataclysm destroyed the settlements. For reasons lost to time, Athrikus used his arcane mastery to bind his second-in-command, the mage Asterion, in a moonstone seal within Bashal'Aran. Asterion's body perished, but his ghost remained shackled to the ruined shrine.

sections.title: Demonic Infestation
sections.body: Deth'ryll satyrs and grells now claim Bashal'Aran's crumbled stones. Drawn by magic lingering in the ancient masonry, these corrupted beings feed on its energy to strengthen their foul arts. They swarm the broken courtyards and terrorize travelers on Darkshore's forest paths, yet keep clear of the central shrine, where Asterion endures his endless vigil.

faq.q: What was Bashal'Aran before it was destroyed?
faq.answer: Before its destruction, Bashal'Aran was a magnificent Kaldorei city where Queen Azshara settled favored Highborne aristocrats. The mage-lord Athrikus Narassin governed it alongside its twin, Ameth'Aran.

faq.q: Who is the ghost wandering the shrine?
faq.answer: The ghost wandering the shrine is Asterion, a respected Highborne warrior-mage who once oversaw Bashal'Aran and Ameth'Aran. His governor, Athrikus Narassin, mysteriously betrayed him and bound him to the site with a moonstone seal. Asterion remains imprisoned beyond mortal death.

faq.q: Why are satyrs inhabiting the ruins?
faq.answer: Satyrs and grells came to Bashal'Aran, drawn by arcane energy left by the ancient Highborne. They feed on its lingering magic to strengthen their dark demonic arts.

faq.q: How does Bashal'Aran relate to Ameth'Aran?
faq.answer: Bashal'Aran and Ameth'Aran were sister cities governed together under Queen Azshara. Asterion often journeyed between them to tend to the people's needs before the Sundering shattered both settlements.

angles.text: As a Night Elf, Bashal'Aran recalls the arcane hubris that doomed the ancient Kaldorei Empire and left its ruins open to demonic corruption.
As a Mage, Asterion's moonstone seal shows how Highborne spellcraft can bind a spirit beyond mortal death.
